question: Find the IDS and names of countries that have more than 3 car makers and produce fiat.
gold_query: select t1.countryid , t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid = t2.country group by t1.countryid having count(*) > 3 union select t1.countryid , t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid = t2.country join model_list as t3 on t2.id = t3.maker where t3.model = 'fiat'

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName FROM countries JOIN car_makers ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryId WHERE car_makers.Maker = 'fiat' GROUP BY countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName HAVING COUNT(car_makers.Id) > 3"}
